nodes.label: 3DS / requires_action coverage gap
nodes.rationale: Three routes return {requires_action, client_secret} but only the false branch is tested. SCA makes this the normal path for European cards and Indian mandates require it, so a silent no-op reads to the user as 'I clicked upgrade and nothing happened' while Stripe holds an unconfirmed PaymentIntent.

nodes.label: Declined card at checkout UI unexercised
nodes.rationale: Decline handling is unit-tested server-side (invoice.payment_failed, payment_intent.payment_failed) but a decline at the embedded sheet is never typed, so recovery, buyer messaging and stranded pending rows are all unknown.

nodes.label: Disputes are deliberately webhook-driven
nodes.rationale: The real dispute card is not used and should not be: a real dispute takes days to close and the webhook IS the integration surface. Dispute handling is proven; dispute origination is not, by choice.

nodes.label: DEFECT: a canceled subscription can resolve as Pro
nodes.rationale: orgPlanKey has no arm for status='canceled'; syncSubscription writes plan_key from the price, so a missed customer.subscription.deleted webhook plus a needsRenewalResync-triggered resync leaves status='canceled', plan_key='pro' — free Pro forever, and it never self-heals because needsRenewalResync returns false for canceled.

nodes.label: orgPlanKey canceled arm (the chosen fix)
nodes.rationale: Adding the resolver arm was chosen over forcing plan_key='community' in syncSubscription because it fixes every already-poisoned row, not just future writes, and makes the resolver self-sufficient instead of dependent on one webhook handler having run.

nodes.label: STATUS_MAP status collapsing
nodes.rationale: unpaid/paused/incomplete all map to past_due so they hit the 14-day grace and degrade on schedule; canceled is the hole. incomplete→past_due grants 14 days of full Pro with no successful payment; paused→past_due starts the degrade clock as an unexamined consequence.

nodes.label: Non-inlinable org_has_feature on public views
nodes.rationale: V306's security definer + SET search_path versions cannot be planner-inlined and public_discovery_v calls it 3x/row. The competition_passes RLS requirement makes the invoker/inline form unavailable, so if it is slow the fix is a materialised entitlement, not reverting the function.

nodes.label: Flyway outOfOrder and the cross-branch migration gap
nodes.rationale: A branch landing a migration numbered inside a gap can be refused on a staging apply without outOfOrder=true; a fresh prod baseline is unaffected.
